entries.zh: 没有尽头；无休无止，事情没有收尾
entries.en: to have no end; endless, never finished

entries.zh: 不安；心神不宁，亦指身体欠安、不健康（对应西语 no tener salud）
entries.en: to be ill at ease, unwell; to lack health or peace of mind

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑谓怎样拼死用力（咬紧牙关）也没有
entries.en: 〔source damaged, gloss uncertain〕apparently: to get nothing, however hard one strives (?)
entries.notes: source_H 第二字存疑（齒/香），M 一处声调 T99 污损，西语 q̃（=que）后的 Llegar abaxo 展开亦不明确，三栏难以定夺。

entries.zh: 临丧不哀；居丧送葬而无哀伤之情，形容毫无悲痛
entries.en: to attend a funeral without grief; to feel no sadness or sorrow
entries.notes: 语义据 L/H/M 三栏清晰可解（临丧不哀，语本《论语》），唯 M 第三字声调 T99 污损难辨，按 T99 规程列低置信。

entries.zh: 不合；不相合、不相投，彼此没有契合
entries.en: to disagree, not to conform; to be without obligation or mutual accord

entries.zh: 无荣；没有荣耀光彩，落得失色蒙羞
entries.en: to have no honor or glory; to be without renown
entries.notes: source_H 第二字存疑（榮/泣），依 M 音 eng 判为「榮」；西语续词 citaruyado 潦草难解。

entries.zh: 闲工；闲散无事，没有活计可做
entries.en: to be idle, to have no work to do; leisure, spare time
entries.notes: source_H 有〔疑：閒/閑〕（异体字，音义无碍），按规程列中置信；西语 enq̃=en que 展开确定。

entries.zh: 无工课；没有活儿可干，闲着无事
entries.en: to have no work or task to do; to be without occupation

entries.zh: 鼻不出；鼻塞不通，鼻涕擤不出来
entries.en: to have a stopped nose, unable to blow it; Spanish continuation illegible
entries.notes: 西语 donde los nayo 潦草难解，释义依 H/M（鼻不出）；语义本身可定，故列中置信。

entries.zh: 无气；没有气力胆气，精神萎靡，缺乏勇气
entries.en: to lack courage or vigor; to be without spirit or energy

entries.zh: 绝灭；绝嗣无后，无子无孙，宗支断绝
entries.en: to have no posterity, no sons or grandsons; to die out, become extinct

entries.zh: 绝后代；断绝后嗣，香火无继
entries.en: to have no descendants; one's line to die out

entries.zh: 无向好；不见好转，没有起色，日趋变坏
entries.en: to take a bad turn, to show no sign of improvement; to be no good

entries.zh: 免发力；不必费力，用不着使劲
entries.en: no need to exert oneself; not to tire or strain over it

entries.zh: 免费心机；不必费神劳心，用不着绞尽脑汁
entries.en: no need to rack one's brains; to spare oneself mental trouble
entries.notes: source_H 末字存疑（橈/撓），依 M 音 quy（=ki）推为「機」，义读「免废心机」，故列中置信。

entries.zh: 无了；没完没了，无休无止
entries.en: endless, without end; never to be finished

entries.zh: 不合理；不合情理，没有道理
entries.en: unreasonable; to be without reason, not right

entries.zh: 不合；不相合、不相投
entries.en: to disagree; not to conform or accord

entries.zh: 无道理；没有道理，说不过去
entries.en: to be without reason; unreasonable, unjustified

entries.zh: 不值钱；一文不值，毫无价值
entries.en: to be worth nothing; worthless, of no value

entries.zh: 隔断；隔绝，断绝往来，从此不再相见
entries.en: to be cut off, separated; never to see one another again

entries.zh: 绝断不来；断绝往来，彼此不再登门相见
entries.en: to break off relations, no longer to visit one another
entries.notes: 西语 el foltia 潦草难辨（疑为 flota/falta 之讹），释义依 H/M（絕斷不來）。
